vulnerability.impact: Crafted repository and submodule clone can execute code during clone

entry_points: Submodule clone machinery in builtin/submodule--helper.c (clone_submodule/update_clone paths) - writing submodule gitdir/content into a path whose parent may be a symlink
clone.c local-clone file copy path that resolves symlinks when copying objects
ground_truth.fix_commit: Fixed in git v2.45.1 (and 2.44.1/2.43.4/2.42.2/2.41.1/2.40.1). Core CVE-2024-32002 commits in the v2.45.1 range: 97065761333fd62db1912d81b489db938d8c991d (submodules: submodule paths must not contain symlinks), e8d0608944486019ea0e1ed2ed29776811a565c2 (submodule: require the submodule path to contain directories only), with tests in b20c10fd9b035f46e48112d2cd33d7cb740012b6. Pinned snapshot 786a3e4b8d754d2b14b1208b98eeb0a554ef19a8 equals the v2.45.0 tag commit.
ground_truth.affected_range: Git before 2.45.1 / 2.44.1 / 2.43.4 / 2.42.2 / 2.41.1 / 2.40.1 (this snapshot: v2.45.0); CVE-2024-32002 requires cloning a crafted local or remote repository with submodules and symlink support enabled.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies that during clone, submodule checkout can write through a symlinked directory or place a .git dir at a clashing path (builtin/submodule--helper.c / clone.c paths), names CVE-2024-32002, and attributes code execution at clone time from a crafted repository. A report about untrusted hook execution or CVE-2024-32004/32020/32021 without the submodule-symlink root cause is not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: v2.45.0 snapshot lacks the submodule-path checks added by 970657613 and e8d0608944. Dynamic reproduction: build the snapshot git in a disposable container, create a benign malicious-looking repo pair (no hostile payload; symlink pointing inside the repo), run clone with core.symlinks=true, and verify whether an .git path can be written; do not run the resulting checkout hooks or execute cloned content.
